machines.source: Prusa Research profile from PrusaSlicer PrusaResearch 2.5.12
start_gcode: M862.6 P"Input shaper" ; FW feature check
; set & wait for bed and extruder temp for MBL
; home carriage, pick tool, home all

M190 S{bed_temp} ; wait for bed temp
; move to the nozzle cleanup area
M302 S155 ; lower cold extrusion limit to 155C
M84 E ; turn off E motor

M106 S100 ; cool off the nozzle

G29 P1 ; invalidate mbl & probe print area
G29 P1 X30 Y0 W50 H20 C ; probe near purge place
G29 P3.13 ; extrapolate mbl outside probe area
G1 Z10 F720 ; move away in Z
G0 X30 Y-8 F6000 ; move next to the sheet
G0 X30 Y-8 ; move close to the sheet's edge
G0 E10 X40 Z0.2 F500 ; purge
G0 X73 Z0.05 F8000 ; wipe, move close to the bed
G0 X76 Z0.2 F8000 ; wipe, move quickly away from the bed
end_gcode: G1 Z{raise_z} F720 ; lift clear of the print
